card.name: The word work after a person or group
card.fires_on: The noun "work" (sometimes "project" or "projects") meaning someone's professional output, right after a possessive or a person's role. Seen in web text about researchers, foundations and communities.

modes.description: "work" follows a person's name or possessive and refers to their professional activity.
